notes: Added missing stories to complete lifecycle coverage: revocation API, validation integration, and tests.

stories.title: Token Revocation Service and API Endpoint
stories.description: Implement revocation capability allowing tokens to be invalidated before expiration. Provide internal service method and API endpoint to revoke by token_id or lineage (cascade revocation). Ensure revoked_at is persisted and enforced in validation.

stories.title: Token Validation Integration in GPTReader
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle checks (expiration, revocation, rotation lineage) into GPTReader request authentication flow. All incoming bearer tokens must be validated against storage and rejected if expired or revoked.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop comprehensive tests covering token issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, and validation enforcement. Include negative cases (expired, revoked, tampered tokens) and integration tests with GPTReader endpoints.
